purpose: Underlying filing and coordinate model for the repository. The public root is deliberately reduced to two branches, AXIS and WORLD; scale, domain, time, epistemic status and graph relationships remain independent coordinates.

root_order.label: AXIS
root_order.meaning: Meaning-bearing, spiritual, symbolic, psychological and project-defined structures.

root_order.label: WORLD
root_order.meaning: Observable people, places, institutions, networks, objects, events, records and material systems.

axis_layers.label: SOURCE
axis_layers.meaning: Origin, Father, creation and spiritual-source concepts.

axis_layers.label: MEANING
axis_layers.meaning: Ideas, symbols, principles, visions and interpretations.

axis_layers.label: BELIEF / FAITH
axis_layers.meaning: Religions, theology, doctrines, traditions and spiritual convictions.

axis_layers.label: MYTHS
axis_layers.meaning: Myths, sacred stories, mythological figures, narratives and cosmologies.

axis_layers.label: PSYCHOLOGY
axis_layers.meaning: Behaviour, development, personality, cognition and inner life.

axis_layers.label: HAWKINSCALE
axis_layers.meaning: The project's comparative consciousness/emotion model, including its evidence boundaries.

axis_layers.label: NEUROBIOLOGY
axis_layers.meaning: Brain, nervous system and embodied-cognition research.

world_layers.label: WORLDS & DOMAINS
world_layers.meaning: Broad environments, fields, civilizations and domains of activity.

world_layers.label: INSTITUTIONS & STRUCTURES
world_layers.meaning: Durable organizations, authorities, infrastructures and coordinating structures.

world_layers.label: NETWORKS & GROUPS
world_layers.meaning: Connected populations, communities, markets, alliances and movements.

world_layers.label: PEOPLE & LIVING ACTORS
world_layers.meaning: Persons, populations and other living participants.

world_layers.label: EVENTS & ACTIONS
world_layers.meaning: Things that happen, change, move or are done.

world_layers.label: RECORDS & SIGNALS
world_layers.meaning: Texts, measurements, documents, datasets and other observable traces.

world_layers.label: GROUND / GRAIN / DUST
world_layers.meaning: Smallest concrete trace or material unit relevant to the investigation.

principle: The visible repository is simple: AXIS / WORLD. AXIS holds meaning-bearing, symbolic, spiritual and inner-experience material. WORLD uses the existing concrete scale because scale is the strongest organizing coordinate for observable systems. Domain, time, epistemic status and graph relationships remain independent.
axis_rule: AXIS is a presentation branch, not a claim that symbolic material is empirically superior to the world. Project canon, interpretation, religious self-description, psychology and scientific interpretation retain their own epistemic classes.
hawkinscale_rule: Hawkinscale is a framework record, not a claim that its numerical levels are physical frequencies or universally validated measurements. data/hawkins-scale.json remains the substantive source for the model and its evidence safeguards.
lexicon_rule: Small lexicon entries remain accessible reference material but should not dominate navigation. Substantive records carry the visual weight.
door_rule: Door is not a filing branch. It describes transformation, passage or interface and remains available as a concept and graph relationship.
other_concept_rule: Axis, Ladder, Tree of Life, Tree of Strife, transformation, return and similar interpretive structures remain concepts, relationships or framework elements rather than forced top-level filing categories.
placement_rule: Give each record one primary repository home. Use cross-links and graph edges rather than duplicate records solely for navigation. A record's domain, time and epistemic status may cross the two branches.
canonical_overrides: Use data/repository-scale.json for explicit WORLD scale placements. AXIS placement is resolved by explicit project classification before broad keyword fallback.

independent_coordinates.scale: Canonical WORLD granularity from Worlds & Domains through Ground / Grain / Dust.
independent_coordinates.domain: Religion, mythology, geography, politics, economy, science, technology, culture, security and other domains can occur at every scale.
independent_coordinates.time: Past, present and future can occur at every scale.
independent_coordinates.epistemic_status: Observable world, historical/textual record, project theory/research model and Potatoism/mythic canon remain explicitly separated.
independent_coordinates.graph: Relationships may connect any records across AXIS and WORLD and across any scale. The graph is not subordinate to the tree.
independent_coordinates.33_level_axis: Project-defined vertical framework retained as a deeper navigational and interpretive coordinate.

non_goals: Do not create a third public root branch.
Do not delete or flatten the existing 33-level framework.
Do not treat AXIS or WORLD as a hierarchy of truth, value or power.
Do not use Door as a filing category.
Do not flatten the graph into the tree.
Do not create duplicate records solely to satisfy navigation.
Do not proliferate small subcategories merely to make the taxonomy look complete.
